selected.title: LocalAI 5.0: Turn a Folder of Notes Into a Word File on Your Own Server
selected.summary: The LocalAI v5.0.0 release adds Projects, a Files area and the Simple Office add-on, which can save a Word summary from uploaded notes. The desktop builds target Apple silicon and Linux. A Project is organization, not a permission boundary.
selected.availability: MIT-licensed code. Desktop builds for Apple silicon and Linux. A suitable local model and the Simple Office add-on are required.
selected.practical_use: Try one notes-to-Word workflow using invented files and a local model.

source_review.excerpt: the Simple Office add-on reads, edits and creates Word, Excel and PowerPoint files
source_review.decision: Read the v5.0.0 release published November 18, matching README/license, Projects and Office instructions. Reviewed the local-server path and file permission boundary.

editorial_review.viewer_question: Can my self-hosted model read my sample notes and save an editable Word file?
editorial_review.prerequisites: A compatible v5.0.0 installation, a locally hosted model with tool support, file permissions and Simple Office.
editorial_review.central_task: Try one notes-to-Word workflow using invented files and a local model.
editorial_review.new_capability: v5.0.0 brings project files and Office creation tools into the LocalAI chat workflow.
editorial_review.closest_archive_coverage: October 5 covered vLLM model startup. October 12 covered MCP reference servers. Neither covered a local notes-to-Word workflow.
editorial_review.supported_payoff: Give LocalAI a folder of notes and ask it to save a one-page Word summary alongside them.
editorial_review.evidence_mode_reason: Documented GitHub release and Office walkthrough.
editorial_review.alternatives: Separate releases from the other providers were reviewed for their own audiences.

editorial_review.availability_limitation: Start with dummy files. Projects do not isolate access. We inspected the release and docs without running LocalAI.
